How Much Does a Hot Tub Cost?

A mid-range acrylic hot tub costs about $6,000 to $12,000, plus $1,000 to $5,000 for wiring, a pad and delivery. Expect $30 to $100 a month for electricity, chemicals and upkeep, depending on size, insulation and climate.
